issues.summary: A ready story with a missing, escaping, or duplicate Control Plane locator remains startable because create_run validates only state, claimable_roles, and diagnostic_codes. ProjectView mirrors that incomplete check, and apps/api/app/worker.py catches WorkflowDocumentError and silently returns an empty spec note. The result is a 201 run that can dispatch an agent with only the title after document/prompt resolution failed. This violates the unsafe-work-inert scenario and the duplicate/unsafe-locator case requiring prompt refusal to surface the problem. Gate run creation on one safe current document and make dispatch surface resolution failure; add negative API and prompt tests.

The snapshot models are not strict, so structurally invalid v1 records can be accepted and rewritten instead of producing the required explicit upstream error. A direct probe with story_counts.ready set to the JSON string 1 validated successfully and returned integer 1. The invalid-output case currently tests only malformed JSON, another version, and missing fields. Make the v1 boundary strict and add wrong-type record cases so the adapter does not coerce upstream data.

The required repository-wide Ruff command is red with 19 errors, so the ticket Done When and close gate are not satisfied. Review confirmed every failure is pre-existing in unchanged apps/api/tests/conftest.py, test_dispatch.py, and test_run_lifecycle.py, while all ticket 009 Python paths are clean. Those files are outside allowed_paths, so resolve the baseline in a prerequisite or explicitly rescope/amend validation before close rather than changing them under ticket 009.

suggestions: The ticket and new workflow test are untracked, so the claimed unchanged 20-row cases table has no committed RED baseline for the reviewer to diff. Preserve a committed contract baseline for future builder passes.
